title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: Crawfish Frogs (Rana areolata) are a species of conservation concern in all 13 states they occur. These secretive frogs spend most of their lives underground in crayfish burrows, emerging briefly during the spring to breed. This image captures a male chorusing in a wetland in Eastern Oklahoma, USA. Photo by Owen M. Edwards, Oklahoma Biological Survey. See ‘Using Spatially-nested Hierarchical Species Distribution Models to Estimate Current and Future Distributions of a Cryptic Species at a Regional Scale (https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/1365-2656.70248)’ for more information.
